publications.task_summary: Validate input preconditions while preserving the target business contract
publications.root_cause: Unchecked input preconditions can violate a caller's contract.
publications.solution: Validate missing and blank text, integer syntax and range, and collection/index preconditions separately. Choose fallback values and numeric rejection rules from the target's original tests; never copy source defaults.
publications.verification: Source verified by independent tests; every target must independently validate its own contract.
applicability: Apply only after confirming equivalent input preconditions in the target.
Confirm target-specific defaults, rejection policies and boundary rules against its original tests.
